blocks.body: KATIC brings its integrated design-and-build practice to Dubai, with a local presence and the full capability of our India teams. Our approach responds to Dubai’s climate, contemporary urban environment, lifestyle and project requirements. We focus on thoughtful planning, natural light, materials, functionality and refined detailing.
